task.description: Step 02: Apply the test fix to TC-ISS-203-02. Root cause (Step 1) is a schema mismatch caused by PAR-01 partitioning (commit 38cb7967, migration 1147_par01_events_partitioning.sql) which deliberately dropped the uq_event_idempotency UNIQUE index on events(idempotency_key) and moved global uniqueness to the non-partitioned sidecar table plat_event_idempotency(idempotency_key) PRIMARY KEY. The test was authored pre-PAR-01 and still issues INSERT INTO events ... ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING, which now fails with SQLSTATE 42P10 (no unique/exclusion constraint matching ON CONFLICT specification). Apply the minimal-change pattern: add a preceeding INSERT INTO plat_event_idempotency ... ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING that absorbs the duplicate before the events INSERT runs. No production code change, no migration. Verify with: zig build test-integration-iss203 (or appropriate step) — must pass all 5 cases. Also add a small regression note in the test file referencing PAR-01/GH-764 so the next reader sees the schema dependency.

context.root_cause: Class A: schema mismatch. After PAR-01 (commit 38cb7967, migration 1147_par01_events_partitioning.sql) the uq_event_idempotency UNIQUE index on events(idempotency_key) was deliberately dropped (lines 162-164). Global idempotency-key uniqueness now lives in plat_event_idempotency(idempotency_key) PRIMARY KEY (lines 176-201). The test at tests/integration/iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig:367-380 still issues INSERT INTO events ... ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING against a partitioned table that no longer has the unique index on idempotency_key, producing SQLSTATE 42P10. Verified via direct psql probe and the live test-integration-iss203 run.

result.summary: Applied minimal-change fix to TC-ISS-203-02. The pre-PAR-01 test issued INSERT INTO events ... ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING against the partitioned events table, which after PAR-01 (commit 38cb7967, migration 1147_par01_events_partitioning.sql) no longer carries a unique index on idempotency_key and so returns SQLSTATE 42P10. Fix mirrors the production dedup pattern at src/event_store/store.zig:288-294: a preceeding INSERT INTO plat_event_idempotency (idempotency_key, event_id, created_at) VALUES ($1, gen_random_uuid(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING is now the dedup target; the events INSERT replaces ON CONFLICT (... idempotency_key) with a NOT EXISTS subquery against plat_event_idempotency. Added a comment block referencing GH-764 / ISS-0699 / PAR-01 so the next reader sees the schema dependency. No production code change, no migration. Verified: zig build test-integration-iss203 reports 'Build Summary: 6/6 steps succeeded; 5/5 tests passed' (scratch/gh764_iss203_postfix.log). Committed on feature/WF03-GH764-20260813 as 4174a1ad (no push yet — Step Final will push).
